arguments.heading: What happened at the argument

The victim's counsel argued the officer's immunity claim was mistaken. He contended the lower court ruling was incorrect.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of the Fifth Amendment in civil litigation. It asks if the privilege against self-incrimination limits police conduct during interrogations. The outcome defines the boundary between criminal procedure and civil liability.
